summary: Folder view fix: listing photos in a folder now matches the folder path from the start of the file path (and escapes _ and % wildcards), so a folder no longer also shows photos from similarly named or nested-elsewhere folders (e.g. /backup/photos/a_b or /photos/a-b). Still scoped to the owner's own photos.

statements.why: Query keeps ownerId = userId filter (view-repository.ts:41); the change only narrows results. No security or data risk.

statements.text: The agent changed server/src/repositories/view-repository.ts in a way plain can't describe yet. Ask the agent what it does differently.

misses.what: Visible fix in the Folders view: opening a folder used to also show photos from other folders whose path merely contained the same name (e.g. /backup/photos/x, or a-b vs a_b); now only photos directly in that folder appear.
